prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: exactly one compact square game status icon for a persistent combat buff counter

Consumer contract:
The icon represents a global drain-percentage bonus that persists for the entire combat and can stack without limit. It is shown both as a normal power icon and as a larger inspection icon, with the same artwork scaled down to 64 and 32 pixels.

Primary request:
Create exactly one centered hard-edged magical emblem. Build one crisp purple-and-gold infinity ring from solid polished enamel and gilded metal. Lock one faceted cyan-blue life crystal into the exact center. Mount exactly four discrete sharp attack-star gemstones on the ring, with their tips and small engraved gold arrows following the loop back toward the central life crystal. The repeated inward circuit and the brighter cyan facets inside the center crystal communicate attack energy converted into lasting recovery and endlessly increasing drain percentage.

Style and material:
Polished fantasy card-game UI icon, clean anime magical-girl design language, solid faceted gemstone, precise gilded geometry, saturated violet and indigo enamel, cyan-blue life crystal, strong readable silhouette, hard controlled edges, high contrast at 32 pixels. All highlights are reflections contained entirely inside the physical enamel, metal, and gemstone surfaces.

Composition:
One compact connected emblem centered in the canvas. The infinity loop is the dominant silhouette, the life crystal is the unmistakable focal point, and all four attack-star gemstones remain attached to the loop. Generous clear space on every side. Every visible mark remains far inside the canvas.

Constraints:
No emitted light outside the emblem silhouette. No external halo, bloom, aura, fog, haze, soft color cloud, scattered particles, streaks beyond the ring, ground shadow, cast shadow, frame, badge plate, second icon, text, letters, numbers, watermark, person, face, mouth, teeth, weapon, blood, blood drop, liquid, vein, tube, tentacle, or organic gore. No red or crimson liquid-like forms. Do not let any mark touch a canvas edge.
